notes.title: Mandew vs the Colorless Curse version 3.1
notes.content:
A minor update fixing the wonky screenshots the game was taking when set to full screen mode.

[b]Version 3.1 - January 31, 2021[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed screenshots not saving properly in full screen mode.
[*]In addition to F12, F9 and the assignable screenshot button will also send the screenshot to Steam.
[/list]
